tests.name: GET /api/v1/app-config answers 200 JSON, no auth, with every flag off and min version 0.0.0
build-info answers JSON (the runner confirms the verified commit from it)

tests.reason: Token registration (POST /api/v1/notifications/token) and push dispatch are writes to the database staging shares with production and sends to real members' devices, so a read-only staging suite cannot exercise them; NATIVE_PUSH_DIRECT_ENABLED and NATIVE_PUSH_APPILIX_GUARD_ENABLED stay unset on staging, so dispatch there is today's. These suites mock Supabase, FCM and Appilix and prove: the switch-off golden fixtures recorded from the unmodified code for all three dispatch sites (130 scenarios), switch-on native routing, badge and duplicate-guard rules, the token route's device_type allowlist with today's rows unchanged, and the app-config kill switches, 503, rate limit, mount and atlas claim.
